articles.headline: Coforge joins SpaceX partner network to deploy Grok AI
articles.brief: Coforge has joined the SpaceX partner network to deploy advanced Grok AI tools for enterprise clients, marking a major expansion of enterprise artificial intelligence integration across global markets.

articles.headline: Adani Ports to acquire Dutch storage operator Evos
articles.brief: Adani Ports has announced plans to purchase Dutch storage operator Evos in a strategic international transaction valued at $2.88 billion, expanding its footprint in European logistics.

articles.headline: Sensex and Nifty record best weekly performance in years
articles.brief: Indian stock exchanges added over 29 lakh crore in investor wealth as Sensex and Nifty rallied, driven by massive foreign institutional buying and lower global crude oil prices.

articles.headline: Delhi invokes GRAP 3 restrictions as air quality worsens
articles.brief: Authorities have enforced Stage III of the Graded Response Action Plan across Delhi-NCR as air quality approaches severe thresholds ahead of festive celebrations, prompting strict localized bans.

articles.headline: New Zealand election enters final day too close to call
articles.brief: The New Zealand general election campaign has entered its final day with polls indicating a razor-thin margin between major political contenders, leaving the ultimate outcome highly unpredictable.

articles.headline: Brent oil benchmark on track for major weekly drop
articles.brief: Global crude oil benchmark Brent is heading toward its steepest weekly decline since 2020 amid mounting evidence of demand destruction and emerging supply surpluses globally.

articles.headline: CBI books Future Retail and Kishore Biyani over fraud
articles.brief: The Central Bureau of Investigation has registered a formal case against Kishore Biyani and Future Retail in connection with an alleged banking fraud exceeding ₹904 crore.

articles.headline: Supreme Court issues contempt notice to Kerala Congress
articles.brief: The Supreme Court has issued a formal contempt notice to Kerala Congress leaders over controversial social media commentary regarding the appointment and position of the Chief Justice of India.

articles.headline: Gujarat Energy signs long-term LNG agreement with Adnoc
articles.brief: Gujarat Energy has entered into a long-term contract with Adnoc to procure 4 million tonnes of liquefied natural gas annually over a ten-year period starting in 2028.

articles.headline: At least two children killed in eastern France bus crash
articles.brief: Local authorities confirmed that a tragic bus collision in eastern France resulted in the deaths of at least two children, prompting immediate emergency response and investigation.

articles.headline: Saudi-led coalition intercepts Houthi drone over Medina
articles.brief: The Saudi-led coalition reported intercepting and destroying an explosive drone over Medina, though Houthi representatives denied launching any attacks targeting the holy city.

articles.headline: Carnatic mridangist Sridhar Parthasarathy passes away on stage
articles.brief: Renowned Carnatic percussionist Sridhar Parthasarathy suffered a fatal heart attack and passed away while performing live during a classical music concert in Pune.
